Enable Developer Mode in the ComfyUI web UI, export the workflow with \"Save (API Format)\" and paste it here. Then set the positive/negative prompt nodes\' text to the placeholders \"%prompt%\" and \"%negative_prompt%\". Optional placeholders: \"%model%\", \"%seed%\", \"%steps%\", \"%scale%\", \"%width%\", \"%height%\", \"%sampler%\", \"%scheduler%\", \"%denoise%\", \"%clip_skip%\" (parameters without a matching placeholder are ignored). After changing, go back to Settings and tap \"Save\".

A native Android client for AI roleplay chat.
tellev is a native client built on SillyTavern-compatible formats, reusing its character cards, world books and core data structures so data stays interchangeable with the original project.
